# Behavioral analysis


## setup 
This script uses the behav.all dataframe from the univariate network script. 

First: make sure we are using the right trial type: 

```{r}
behav.all.here = behav.all %>% filter(remembered==1,conditionName == "remember")

behav.remembered = behav.all %>% filter(remembered==1,conditionName == "remember")
behav_nr = behav.all %>% filter(conditionName == "remember")


# make sure all variables are factors 
behav.remembered$valenceCategory <- as.factor(behav.remembered$valenceCategory)
behav.remembered$subID <- as.factor(behav.remembered$subID)
behav.remembered$cueWord <- as.factor(behav.remembered$cueWord)

behav_nr$valenceCategory <- as.factor(behav_nr$valenceCategory)
behav_nr$subID <- as.factor(behav_nr$subID)
behav_nr$cueWord <- as.factor(behav_nr$cueWord)

behav.all.here$valenceCategory <- as.factor(behav.all.here$valenceCategory)
behav.all.here$subID <- as.factor(behav.all.here$subID)
behav.all.here$cueWord <- as.factor(behav.all.here$cueWord)


behav.all.here = behav.all.here%>%
  group_by(subID) %>% 
  mutate(regSuccess = scale(regSuccess,scale=FALSE),
         recallVividness = scale(recallVividness,scale=FALSE),
         eventDets = scale(eventDets, scale =FALSE), 
         visualDets = scale(visualDets, scale=FALSE),
         correctDetails = scale(correctDetails, scale=FALSE)) %>% # mean-center within subject
  ungroup()
behav.by.video = behav.all.here %>% group_by(subID, cueWord, valenceCategory) %>%
  summarize(meanSuccess = mean(regSuccess, na.rm=TRUE),
            recallVividness = mean(recallVividness, na.rm=TRUE),
            eventDets = mean(eventDets),
            visualDets = mean(visualDets),
            correctDetails = mean(correctDetails)
                              )

```

```{r}

# look at success standard deviations 
success_sd = behav.all.here %>%
  group_by(valenceCategory) %>%
  summarize(SD_success = sd(regSuccess, na.rm = TRUE))

success_sd

```



## success x vividness

how do the average success ratings predict subsequent vividness ratings? does this vary by valence? 

```{r}
# vividness
behav.by.video$valenceCategory <- factor(behav.by.video$valenceCategory, levels=c("neu", "neg", "pos"))
mod_viv <- lmer(recallVividness ~ meanSuccess * valenceCategory + (1|subID), data=behav.by.video)
summary(mod_viv)
```

## success x details 
How do Day 2 details relate to Day 1 success ratings? 
```{r}
# details
mod_event <- lmer(eventDets ~ meanSuccess * valenceCategory + (1|subID), data=behav.by.video)
summary(mod_event)

mod_percept <- lmer(visualDets ~ meanSuccess * valenceCategory + (1|subID), data=behav.by.video)
summary(mod_percept)

mod_overall <- lmer(correctDetails ~ meanSuccess * valenceCategory + (1|subID), data=behav.by.video)
summary(mod_overall)
```

all variables: 
```{r}
mod_success <- lmer(meanSuccess ~ eventDets * valenceCategory + visualDets* valenceCategory + (1|subID), data=behav.by.video)
summary(mod_success)
```

# Success and univariate fMRI activity  

This section uses the alldata dataframe from parcel_remembered_only.qmd. 

it should already be filtered as needed but let's check again it's the right condition and remembered-only
```{r}
alldata <- alldata %>%
  filter(conditionName == "remember")

 alldata <- alldata %>% filter(remembered == 1)  

```

create fMRI/success dataframe 
```{r}
include_networks = c("DefaultA", "DefaultB", "DefaultC")

# Summarize data
alldata %>%
  # filter to include only some rows
  filter(network %in% include_networks) %>%
  # average over ROIs within a network
  group_by(subID,trial,network, eventDets, visualDets, correctDetails, regSuccess, valenceCategory) %>% 
  summarize(regulationActivity = mean(regulationActivity,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() -> network.data.success
```


## setup model 

```{r}
include_networks = c("DefaultA", "DefaultB", "DefaultC")

model.stats.s = data.frame()

successfunction <- function(curROI, model.stats.s) {

  # subset data for this ROI
 # model
  roiData <- network.data.success %>% filter(network %in% curROI)
  roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels=c("neu", "neg", "pos"))

  
  # skip if there’s no data
  if (nrow(roiData) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ROI: ", curROI, " (no data)")
    return(model.stats.s)  # just return the existing stats
  }

  # fit model
  full.model <- lmer(regulationActivity ~ regSuccess*valenceCategory +
                       (1|subID), data = roiData)
  
  # extract stats
  stats <- data.frame(summary(full.model)$coefficients[2:nrow(summary(full.model)$coefficients),])
  stats <- mutate(stats, ROI=curROI)
  model.stats.s <- rbind(model.stats.s, stats)
   print(tab_model(full.model,title="detail x emotion, neutral reference"))
                  
  return(model.stats.s)
}


model.stats.s <- successfunction("DefaultA",model.stats.s)
model.stats.s <- successfunction("DefaultB",model.stats.s)
model.stats.s <- successfunction("DefaultC",model.stats.s)

```

## Extended Data Figure 1-1b: success x activity 



```{r}

library(lme4)
library(ggeffects)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# make sure valence order is consistent
network.data.success$valenceCategory <- factor(network.data.success$valenceCategory,
                                               levels = c("neu", "neg", "pos"))

# define function to run model + extract predictions for one network
get_preds <- function(cur_net) {
  dat <- network.data.success %>% filter(network == cur_net)
  
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  mod <- lmer(regulationActivity ~ regSuccess * valenceCategory + (1|subID), data = dat)
  preds <- ggpredict(mod, terms = c("regSuccess [all]", "valenceCategory"), type = "fixed")
  preds$network <- cur_net
  return(preds)
}

# run for all three subnetworks
include_networks <- c("DefaultA", "DefaultB", "DefaultC")
pred_activity_all <- map_dfr(include_networks, get_preds)

# relabel for pretty facets
pred_activity_all$network <- recode(pred_activity_all$network,
                                    "DefaultA" = "Core midline",
                                    "DefaultB" = "Dorsomedial",
                                    "DefaultC" = "Medial temporal")

# plot combined predictions
activity_plot <- ggplot(pred_activity_all, 
                        aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ network, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("neu" = "#1f78b4",
                                "neg" = "#e3401a",
                                "pos" = "#33a02c"),
                     labels = c("Neutral", "Negative", "Positive"),
                     name = "Valence") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("neu" = "#1f78b4",
                               "neg" = "#e3401a",
                               "pos" = "#33a02c"),
                    labels = c("Neutral", "Negative", "Positive"),
                    name = "Valence") +
  labs(x = "Subjective success rating (mean centered)",
       y = "Network activity")+
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = .5), 
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = .5), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm")
  )

activity_plot
```
